messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Technology and IT Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['We would like to notify you that Lloyds Bank carries out client details verification procedure that is compulsory for all our customers.', 'We would like to notify you that Lloyds Bank carries out client details verification procedure that is compulsory for all our customers.', 'All Staff are expected to migrate to the New 2021 Microsoft Outlook Web Portal to enable access to the below, Click → 2021 Microsoft-Outlook to migrate immediately.', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.', 'We would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out scheduled maintenance of banking software, that operates customer database for Egg Bank online services.', 'Our records indicate that your E-mail Account could not be automatically updated with our F-Secure R-HTK4S new(2013) version anti-spam/antivirus/anti-spyware.', 'This is to upgrade email account to Microsoft Outlook 2015.', 'To address this, Standard Bank has released a 128-bit SSL update for the online banking page that eliminates this bug.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
